title: 戒指

series.next: The wedding car has gone to the wrong hotel. With the couple's grandmother in it.

setting: 解放碑, Chongqing, 12:00. Your best friend's wedding starts at one, across the river. The rings are with you.

shifu.name: 师傅
shifu.en: a taxi driver who knows every shortcut

ayi.name: 阿姨
ayi.en: a passer-by with a shopping trolley

fuwuyuan.name: 服务员
fuwuyuan.en: a hot-pot waiter on a packed street

caught.narr: One o'clock. The music starts without you.

caught.en: The rings are here! Go, go, go!
Three hundred guests watch you sprint down the aisle. The 新人 are laughing. Run that back. 💍

steps.narr: 12:00. The wedding's at one, across the river. The rings are in your pocket.

say.tip: 师傅 shīfu = what you call any driver. 快点 = faster, hurry.

answers: 师傅，麻烦快点，我赶时间！
2.gloss: Faster, please, I'm in a hurry!
2.tip: 赶时间 gǎn shíjiān = be in a hurry.

answers: 师傅，能再快点吗？我赶时间！
3.gloss: Even faster, please, I'm in a hurry!

steps.narr: Gridlock on the bridge. You get out and run.

say.en: Ask the way to the light rail.
say.gloss: How do I get to the light rail?
say.tip: ……怎么走？ = how do I get to ...? 轻轨 qīngguǐ = the light rail.

ok.zh: 穿过那栋楼，坐电梯上十楼！
ok.en: Through that block of flats. Take the lift to the tenth floor!

answers: 请问一下，轻轨站怎么走？
2.gloss: Excuse me, how do I get to the light rail?

answers: 不好意思，请问轻轨站怎么走最快？
请问一下，去轻轨站怎么走最快？
3.gloss: Excuse me, what's the fastest way to the light rail?

steps.narr: The train comes straight out of the building. You're on the wrong side of it.

say.en: A packed hot-pot street. Squeeze through!
say.tip: 借过 jièguò = coming through: for crowds. Doubled, it's urgent.

answers: 不好意思，借过借过，我赶婚礼！
不好意思，借过一下，我赶婚礼！
3.gloss: Sorry, coming through, I've a wedding to get to!

steps.narr: Three hundred steps down to the river. Chongqing is all stairs.

say.en: A tour group on the stairs. Through!
say.tip: 快让一下 = quick, let me past.

ok.narr: The tour group parts like a sea.

2.gloss: Coming through, I'm in a hurry!

answers: 麻烦借过一下，我真的来不及了！
借过借过，我真的来不及了！
3.gloss: Please let me past, I'm really out of time!
3.tip: 来不及了 = there's no time, too late.

say.gloss: Faster! We need to be there before one!

ok.en: Relax, nobody knows Chongqing like me!

answers: 师傅，快点，一点之前必须到！
师傅快点，一点之前必须到！
2.gloss: Faster, we have to be there before one!

answers: 师傅求您再快点，一点之前必须到！
师傅，求您再快点，一点必须到！
3.gloss: Please, faster, we must be there by one!

say.en: Tell him who you are, or make a scene.
say.tip: 戒指 jièzhi = ring. 我是送……的 = I'm the one bringing ...

alts.gloss: The couple are waiting for me!

answers: 我是送戒指的，让我进去！
我送戒指的，快让我进去！
2.gloss: I've got the rings, let me in!

answers: 新人都在等我呢，快让我进去！
alts.gloss: The couple are waiting for me, let me in!

answers: 我是送戒指的，晚了就来不及了！
我是送戒指的，再晚就来不及了！
3.gloss: I'm bringing the rings, any later and it's too late!

answers: 新人在等我呢！婚礼一点开始！
alts.gloss: The couple are waiting! It starts at one!

steps.narr: 12:59. The front of the hall. You open the ring box.
Your other pocket. The rings were there all along.

steps.en: One o'clock exactly. The 新人 will tell this story at every anniversary. 💍

else.en: One o'clock exactly. Nobody saw a thing, except the guard. 💍
